title: Risk-Sensitive Mission Planning for Multi-Target On-Orbit Inspection via Distributional Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41647v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-target on-orbit servicing missions require planning tools that can adapt to evolving operational conditions while accounting for the outcome variability inherent to safety-critical spaceflight. This paper presents an adaptive planning approach for multi-target servicing campaigns in low Earth orbit and applies it to inspection missions flown by a low-thrust servicer. The approach is based on Distributional Reinforcement Learning, which learns the full distribution of mission returns and thereby supports explicit risk-sensitive decision-making at each planning step. Specifically, a Quantile-Regression Deep Q-Network (QR-DQN) agent selects which target to inspect next by jointly considering the expectation and the variance of the predicted return through a mean-variance criterion. translated_title: 基于分布式强化学习的多目标在轨检查风险敏感任务规划
translated_abstract: 多目标在轨服务任务需要能够适应不断变化的运行条件、同时兼顾安全关键航天活动中固有结果不确定性的规划工具。本文提出了一种面向近地轨道多目标服务活动的自适应规划方法，并将其应用于由低推力服务飞行器执行的检查任务。该方法基于分布式强化学习，通过学习任务回报的完整分布，在每个规划步骤中支持显式的风险敏感决策。具体而言，一个分位数回归深度Q网络（QR-DQN）智能体通过均值-方差准则，联合考虑预测回报的期望与方差，来选择下一个要检查的目标。任务环境建模了具有倾角分布的圆形轨道，并采用Edelbaum的组合机动低推力转移估计方法。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于分布式强化学习（QR-DQN）的自适应规划方法，通过均值-方差准则联合考虑任务回报的期望与方差，为低推力航天器的多目标在轨检查任务实现显式的风险敏感决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive risk-sensitive planning approach based on Distributional Reinforcement Learning (QR-DQN), which jointly considers the expectation and variance of mission returns via a mean-variance criterion, enabling explicit risk-sensitive target selection for multi-target on-orbit inspection by low-thrust servicers.
